entities.name: Eye of Yawgmoth
entities.description: A Phyrexian recording device implanted in Belbe, connected to Yawgmoth so he could see everything.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian progenitor who saw through the Eye.

entities.name: Belbe
entities.description: Killed and resurrected by Phyrexians and implanted with the Eye; fell in love with Ertai and was killed by Eladamri.

entities.name: Ertai
entities.description: Observed by Yawgmoth; loved by Belbe.

entities.name: Greven il-Vec
entities.description: Party to the conflict Yawgmoth observed.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Party to the conflict on Rath; his Coronation was where Belbe died.

entities.name: Crovax's Coronation
entities.description: Event at which Belbe was killed.

events.summary: The Eye of Yawgmoth was implanted in Belbe's body soon after she had been killed and resurrected by Phyrexians.
events.quote: It was implanted in Belbe 's body soon after she had been killed and resurrected by Phyrexians

events.summary: Belbe fell in love with Ertai and tried to blind the Eye with mana-radiation.
events.quote: Belbe eventually fell in love with Ertai

events.summary: Eladamri killed Belbe during Crovax's Coronation.
